briefing.headline: The Gameweek 11 deadline is Saturday 21 November at 11:00 UTC, and João Pedro, Gvardiol and Virgil are the key injury flags to check.

points.text: The Gameweek 11 deadline is 21 November 2026 at 11:00 UTC.
points.label: confirmed

points.text: João Pedro (31.2% owned) has a thigh injury with an unknown return date. Most sold player this week.
points.label: confirmed

points.text: Gvardiol, Virgil, Guéhi, Belloumi and Manzambi are each rated 75% to play. Check their team news before the deadline.
points.label: confirmed

points.text: Price rises are set for Gabriel, Rice, Konsa, N.Jackson and Tavernier. Saka, Madjo, Cook, Brooks and Schade are falling.
